current_date: March 2025 (adopted; companion Minerals & Waste note also adopted March 2025)
current_evidence: The KCC 'Checklist and validation' page links this Reg 3 guidance PDF (plus the separate 'Guidance and validation requirements for mineral and waste developments' PDF and two DOCX checklists). The document text says the notes were 'adopted in March 2025', and a search found no later version.

issues.detail: The List date 2025-08-01 comes from the PDF CreationDate metadata. The document text gives the adoption date as March 2025.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note intro: the guidance and the companion minerals/waste note were 'adopted in March 2025'.

issues.detail: Grokbot put every requirement from the Regulation 3 note under 'Full planning' (most flagged 'INFERRED'), yet the 'County own devt (Reg 3)' row says '(none)'. The note applies only to KCC's own Regulation 3 development, so these belong under Reg 3. Grokbot also mixed in requirements taken only from the minerals & waste note under 'Full planning' instead of 'Minerals & waste (county)'. Examples: Coal Mining/Land Stability, Cycle parking, Parking provision, Employment/Economic Statement, Health Impact Assessment, Odour/Dust/Vibration, Foul Sewage/Utilities and Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note: it 'relates specifically to applications for County Council community development submitted under Regulation 3'; it says separate advice covers County Matter (minerals and waste) applications.

issues.detail: The 'Minerals & waste (county)' row has one entry only: 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details'. Its trigger is advice to contact the Environment Agency about a waste permit, which is neither a refuse storage requirement nor a validation requirement. The real minerals & waste local list (about 23 headed requirements) is missing from this row.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: 'it is strongly recommended to make early contact with the Environment Agency regarding the requirements of the waste permit'. M&W note sections 1-23 list the actual local requirements.

issues.detail: These Reg 3 local requirements were not captured. (1) Green Belt Statement: new built development, change of use or extended use in the Metropolitan Green Belt. (2) Tree Protection Plan (5.3): where existing trees or root protection areas would be affected. (3) Public Rights of Way Statement (7.5): where a proposal could directly affect a PRoW. (4) Development on Playing Field statement (10): school-site proposals on part of a playing field or pitch. (5) Draft Biodiversity Gain Plan (4.2): over 1,000 m2, over 1 ha, or where significant gains are needed. Grokbot has only a generic BNG row whose trigger is the national statutory text. (6) Community Engagement (12): encouraged, not mandatory.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note contents: 3) Green Belt Statement; 5.3 Tree Protection Plan; 7.5 Public Rights of Way Statement; 10) Development on Playing Field; 4.2 Biodiversity Net Gain and draft Gain Plan.

issues.detail: Minerals & waste specific requirements were not captured. Missing: Waste Hierarchy Statement; Circular Economy Statement; Mineral Safeguarding Report/Minerals Assessment; Scheme of Working/Phasing/Landfill Statement; Restoration and Aftercare Plan; Glint and Glare Assessment; Airport Safeguarding; Bioaerosols Risk Assessment; Hydrological and Hydrogeological Assessment; Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (major schemes relying on long-term habitat management); Borehole/Trial Pit analysis; Ancient Woodland/Veteran Trees; Green Belt Statement. Grokbot has a single 'Minerals / Waste specific statements' row whose trigger is the fragment 'nature conservation-based restoration schemes.'
issues.evidence: M&W note sections 4, 5, 6, 9, 11, 13, 14, 17, 18, 20 and 23 (e.g. '13. Waste Hierarchy Statement', '14. Circular Economy Statement', '20. Mineral Safeguarding Report/Minerals Assessment', '23. Airport Safeguarding').

issues.detail: The 'Contaminated Land / Land Contamination Assessment' row uses the Flood Risk Assessment trigger text. The real trigger (8.4) is major applications on known, suspected or potentially contaminated land, or over a Groundwater Source Protection Zone.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: '8.1 Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) 8.1.1 A Flood Risk Assessment is required for any development: in flood zone 2 or 3...'; source 8.4: land contamination investigations required for major applications on known/suspected contaminated land.

issues.detail: The 'Travel Plan' row uses the 7.2 Transport Assessment trigger (large school expansions, new schools, all major development). The real Travel Plan trigger (7.4) is school development that increases pupil or staff numbers, plus non-school development generating significant movement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: '7.2 Transport Assessment 7.2.1 Required for applications for large school expansions...'; source 7.4 Travel Plan: school development increasing pupil/staff numbers.

issues.detail: Two rows have the wrong trigger text. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' uses a SuDS sentence; the real trigger (11, Sustainable Design/Carbon Neutral Statement) is all major applications and Local Plan thresholds. 'Landscaping scheme / Landscape plan' uses the fee text for Details Pursuant applications; the real trigger (5.2) is all major applications, plus minor applications needing landscape mitigation, compensation or restoration.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Energy trigger: 'the most sustainable strategy is proposed taking into account flood risk, site layout, topography, geology'; Landscaping trigger: '8.2 For all Details Pursuant applications, the following is required: The appropriate fee;'.

issues.detail: Many app-type rows have cut-off fragments or headings as triggers, with no real condition. Examples: Cycle parking ('visitor and cycle parking in accordance with relevant local vehicle parking standards.'); Parking ('local vehicle parking standards.'); Health Impact Assessment and Employment/Economic Statement ('a) When Required / Relevant Proposals' only); Ventilation ('would generate odours...'); Highways ('3.3 A BLUE line must be drawn...'); Photographs (BNG exemption text); Planning Obligations (BNG s106 sentence); Ground investigation (SuDS infiltration sentence); Existing/proposed levels ('should include topographic surveys and cross-section drawings.').
issues.evidence: See the trigger_excerpt values in the app_type_rows for these requirements.

issues.detail: Three rows are not requirements. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' was made up from the 5.5 Agricultural Land Classification text; the source has no such requirement, and the row duplicates the ALC row. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' comes from the archaeology trigger sentence and is not a separate requirement. 'Validation checklist form' is real, but Grokbot cites only the minerals note.
issues.evidence: Both rows use the same trigger: '5.5 Agricultural land Classification Assessment 5.5.1 Required for applications proposing large-scale non-agricultural development...'

issues.detail: Grokbot put Flood Risk Assessment and Contaminated Land under 'Change of use - prior approval' because the FRA text mentions 'change of use'. KCC does not decide prior approval applications, and the FRA wording refers to planning applications.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note 8.1.1: 'A Flood Risk Assessment is required for any development: in flood zone 2 or 3 including minor development and change of use'.

issues.detail: Most 'Submission rules' tab_items are process text or fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'Validation Procedure/Invalid Applications 15.' and '18.' (headings with paragraph numbers); the planning.applications@kent.gov.uk email line; 'Application documents in hard copy format and cheques submitted by post should be sent to:' (address lead-in); file-size and GDPR redaction text ending in stray paragraph numbers ('20.', '22.', '23.', '25.', '26.'); the ICO definition of sensitive personal data. The 'Policy-driven requirements' items are reference sources (Natural England Impact Risk Zones via MAGIC, CIEEM, DEFRA habitat management guidance), not requirements.
issues.evidence: tab_items, Submission rules and Policy-driven requirements sections.

issues.detail: Several items repeat across the two notes. The 'Natural England - SSSI (SAC, SPA and Ramsar) Impact Risk Zones (available via DEFRA's MAGIC website)' line appears 4 times. The protected-sites and shadow-HRA text each appear twice. Drawing-standard lines (scale bar, north point, drawing reference) are repeated from both notes.

The Reg 3 note sets out specific information for Details Pursuant (discharge of conditions), Section 73 and Non-Material Amendment applications (Part B). Grokbot marks Discharge of conditions, Variation of condition s73 and Non-material amendment as '(none)'. Householder, LBC, Advertisement, LDC and PiP rows do not apply to a county planning authority and should be marked N/A, not 'national requirements only'.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note contents: 'Part B (other applications) 8) Details Pursuant Applications 9) Section 73 Applications 10) Non-Material Amendment Applications'.

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement trigger is cut short at 'All major development applications'. The source also requires a DAS for floorspace over 100 m2 in a Conservation Area or World Heritage Site.
issues.evidence: Reg 3 note section 5: DAS for major development, or more than 100 m2 floorspace in a Conservation Area/World Heritage Site.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Reg 3 note (adopted March 2025), but its date comes from PDF metadata (Aug 2025). Its extraction puts all Reg 3 requirements under 'Full planning' and leaves the Reg 3 row empty. It also almost entirely misses the minerals & waste local list (waste hierarchy, circular economy, mineral safeguarding, restoration/aftercare, etc.), gets several triggers wrong, and fills the tab with process text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
